title: 环境搭建问题
body:
参考文档上的要求进行环境安装，目前有两个问题，方便请帮忙看下
1.安装  conda install -c quantopian ta-lib=0.4.9
报错如下：
```
UnsatisfiableError: The following specifications were found to be in conflict:
  - matplotlib
  - navigator-updater
  - ta-lib 0.4.9*
Use "conda info <package>" to see the dependencies for each package.
```

2. from vnctpmd import MdApi
ImportError: DLL load failed: 找不到指定的模块。

FROM python:2.7-slim-buster

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Install system dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    git \
    wget \
    libxml2-dev \
    libxslt-dev \
    libssl-dev \
    curl \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install miniconda for ta-lib installation
RUN wget https://repo.continuum.io/miniconda/Miniconda2-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh -O miniconda.sh && \
    bash miniconda.sh -b -p /opt/conda && \
    rm miniconda.sh

# Add conda to path
ENV PATH /opt/conda/bin:$PATH

# Clone the repository and checkout the specific commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/vnpy/vnpy.git . && \
    git checkout 9eee8ea166c62443897be61cbb54bb07053a73a5

# Install ta-lib from source (to avoid the dependency conflict mentioned in the issue)
RUN wget http://prdownloads.sourceforge.net/ta-lib/ta-lib-0.4.0-src.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzf ta-lib-0.4.0-src.tar.gz && \
    cd ta-lib && \
    ./configure --prefix=/usr && \
    make && \
    make install && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf ta-lib-0.4.0-src.tar.gz ta-lib

# Install Python dependencies using pip
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

# Install numpy first as it's required by many packages
RUN pip install numpy==1.16.6

# Install TA-Lib Python wrapper
RUN pip install ta-lib==0.4.9

# Install other Python dependencies
RUN pip install \
    pandas==0.24.2 \
    matplotlib==2.2.5 \
    scipy==1.2.3 \
    six \
    pyzmq==19.0.2 \
    pymongo==3.12.3 \
    websocket-client==0.58.0 \
    msgpack-python==0.5.6 \
    qdarkstyle==2.8.1 \
    qtpy==1.9.0 \
    requests==2.27.1 \
    flask==1.1.4 \
    flask-socketio==4.3.1 \
    python-socketio==4.6.0 \
    python-engineio==3.13.2 \
    flask-restful==0.3.9 \
    lxml==4.6.5

# Install additional dependencies that might be needed
RUN conda install -y -c conda-forge boost

# Build the project
RUN cd /app && python setup.py install

# Create necessary configuration directories and files
RUN mkdir -p ~/.vnpy
RUN echo '{}' > ~/.vnpy/vt_setting.json

# Set environment variables
ENV LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
ENV LANG=C.UTF-8

# Note: The DLL load issue is specific to Windows and can't be fully addressed in Docker
# This Dockerfile prepares the environment with all dependencies installed

CMD ["echo", "vnpy environment is ready with ta-lib and all dependencies installed"]
